The "Apollo 13" movie, with the module pilot Fred Haise played by Bill Paxton, portrayed Jack Swigert, played by Kevin Bacon, as unprepared for the flight. However, this was untrue, as Swigert was very familiar with the module, having also long worked on developing it. The dialogue between ground control and the astronauts was taken nearly verbatim from transcripts and recordings, with the exception of the famous tagline of the film, "Houston, we have a problem." According to audio of the air-to-ground communications, the actual words uttered by Swigert were "Okay, Houston, we've had a problem here". Ground control responded by saying, "This is Houston. Say again, please." Jim Lovell then repeated, "Houston, we've had a problem."

In the actual re-entry, the Command Module's transmission was not resumed with Tom Hanks (as Lovell) saying "Hello Houston... this is Odyssey... it's good to see you again." Instead, the actual transmission was not heard until the module splashed down in the Pacific Ocean.
